configuration.title: Stylelint+
configuration.enable: Control whether Stylelint+ is enabled for CSS/SCSS/Less files or not.
configuration.autoFixOnSave: Turns auto fix on save on or off.
configuration.disableErrorMessage: Whether to turn off the display of error messages.
configuration.run: Controls when Stylelint validation is triggered.
configuration.run.onSave: Validate only when the file is saved
configuration.run.manual: Validate only when manually triggered via command
configuration.configFile: Path to a Stylelint configuration file. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root. Takes precedence over stylelint.config.
configuration.ignorePath: Path to a .stylelintignore file. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root. When empty, auto-discovers .stylelintignore by walking up from the document.
configuration.ignoreNodeModules: Whether to skip validation for files inside node_modules directories.
configuration.rules.customizations: Override the severity of specific Stylelint rules. Use 'off' to suppress a rule entirely.
configuration.codeAction.disableRuleComm: Show disable rule in the quick fix menu.
Where to insert the disable comment.
